data.long_meaning: Jesh is a name derived from the Hebrew language, which means 'God is gracious'. In biblical times, it was a common name among the Israelites and is mentioned in several books of the Old Testament. Jesh can be used for both boys and girls and carries a spiritual significance of being blessed by God.
